findings.description: Removing the custom __reduce_ex__ means pickling a sentinel falls back to Enum's default reduce, which serializes the raw object() value. Unpickling then calls Sentinel(<new object>), which fails because the new object is not identical to the member's value.
findings.rationale: Trigger: pickle.dumps of an object holding UNSET or FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE, such as a Context or parameter default, followed by pickle.loads. Mechanism: the restored value is a fresh object() that matches no member, so Enum lookup raises ValueError. Impact: unpickling fails with an error instead of restoring the sentinel identity that the removed code preserved by name.
